verified_facts: DSM includes vehicles, buildings and vegetation as well as terrain
DTM removes surface objects to model terrain surface
DSM and DTM can share source survey lineage
both products may use the newest best-resolution survey where repeats exist
DSM values are not ground elevation by definition
candidate ground-height calculation must use DTM while DSM is only a semantic/negative control
quality_effect: Prevents buildings/vegetation/vehicles in DSM from contaminating terrain height measurements.
